description.value: Jugo Juice – Robson is a health-focused juice and smoothie bar on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, part of a Canadian franchise founded in Calgary in 1998 with roughly 100 locations coast to coast. The menu covers made-to-order smoothies, fresh-pressed juices, bubble teas, smoothie bowls, and a food selection of wraps and grilled cheeses, with strong vegan and vegetarian coverage throughout. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and the location offers a catering service featuring wraps, grilled cheeses, and smoothies.
